title: Graceful Shutdown with In-Flight Request Drain
description: Adds a production‑ready graceful shutdown mechanism that stops accepting new connections, waits for ongoing requests to complete, and then exits the process. This prevents dropped requests during deployments or restarts, improving reliability and user experience.
testCases: Verify that new requests are rejected after SIGTERM is received while existing requests continue processing
Confirm the process exits with code 0 after all in‑flight requests finish or a timeout is reached
acceptance: When a SIGTERM or SIGINT signal is sent, the server stops accepting new connections, allows up to 10 seconds for active requests to complete, then exits cleanly. If requests exceed the timeout, they are terminated and the process still exits. All related unit and integration tests pass.
reason: Ensures zero‑downtime deployments and protects against abrupt termination of client requests, a critical requirement for production services using yantraverse.
